notes.change_extrusion_role_gcode: G-code written each time the print moves to another feature, such as outer wall, sparse infill or support.
notes.change_filament_gcode: G-code run on every filament change, including the T command that picks the tool.
notes.extruder_start_gcode: G-code written right after the printer selects a tool, at the start and at every tool change.
notes.emit_machine_limits_to_gcode: Writes the machine's speed and acceleration limits at the start of the G-code, so the printer uses the same limits as the time estimate. Ignored on Klipper.
notes.file_start_gcode: G-code at the very top of the file, before the header. Use it for lines a printer or host reads first.
notes.layer_change_gcode: G-code run at every layer change, after the nozzle moves up.
notes.machine_end_gcode: G-code run when the whole print finishes, such as turning the heaters off and parking the head.
notes.machine_pause_gcode: The G-code for a pause you add at a layer in the preview.
notes.machine_start_gcode: G-code run before the print starts, such as homing, heating, leveling and a purge line.
notes.printing_by_object_gcode: G-code run before each object after the first when printing by object, before the nozzle comes down.
notes.template_custom_gcode: G-code for a custom action you add at a layer in the preview.
notes.thumbnails: Preview image sizes to embed in the G-code, such as 48x48/PNG, for the printer's screen.
notes.thumbnails_format: Image format of the G-code previews. PNG is sharpest, JPG is smallest, and QOI suits firmware with little memory; pick what the printer's screen reads.
notes.time_lapse_gcode: G-code for a timelapse frame on every layer. Most printers run it right after the layer change.
notes.wrapping_detection_gcode: G-code for the printer's filament wrapping check, run on every layer when wrapping detection is on.
notes.adaptive_bed_mesh_margin: Extra margin around the print for an adaptive bed mesh, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_custom_model: A 3D model shown as the bed in the app. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_custom_texture: An image shown on the bed in the app. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_exclude_area: Areas of the bed nothing may print on, such as where a printer cuts filament. Parts placed there are flagged before printing.
notes.bed_mesh_max: The far corner of the area the bed mesh may probe, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_mesh_min: The near corner of the area the bed mesh may probe, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_mesh_probe_distance: Spacing between bed mesh probe points, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_temperature_formula: Which filament sets the bed temperature when a plate prints several: the first one, or the highest bed temperature among them.
notes.best_object_pos: Where on the bed auto arrange centers parts, as fractions of its width and depth. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.default_bed_type: The bed plate the printer starts with. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.disable_m73: Leaves out the M73 commands that tell the printer how much time is left.
notes.enable_power_loss_recovery: Turns the printer's power loss recovery on or off from the G-code, or leaves the printer's own setting. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.extruder_clearance_dist_to_rod: Distance from the nozzle to the gantry rod. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.extruder_clearance_height_to_lid: Height from the nozzle tip to the top of the toolhead or lid, in mm. Used to check that printing by object won't collide.
notes.extruder_clearance_height_to_rod: Height from the nozzle tip to the gantry rod, in mm. When printing by object, parts taller than this must print last.
notes.extruder_clearance_radius: Space the toolhead takes up around the nozzle, in mm. When printing by object, parts must sit at least this far apart.
notes.extruder_colour: Color shown for this extruder in the app.
notes.extruder_offset: Where this extruder's nozzle sits relative to the first one, in mm, on printers with several nozzles.
notes.toolchange_park_position: Where the head goes before and after each extruder's tool change, in printer coordinates. UltiMaker printers switch print cores there.
notes.extruder_printable_area: The area each extruder can reach, on printers with several printheads.
notes.extruder_printable_height: The height each extruder can reach. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.extruder_type: Direct drive puts the motor on the toolhead; Bowden pushes filament through a long tube, which usually needs longer retraction.
notes.farthest_point_timelapse: Takes timelapse shots at the point farthest from the camera. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.gcode_flavor: The dialect of G-code the printer's firmware speaks, such as Marlin 2 or Klipper. A wrong choice can make temperatures, speeds or retraction misbehave.
notes.gcode_skip_config_block: Leaves the settings block out of the end of the G-code. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.max_layer_height: The thickest layer this nozzle can print, in mm. Limits variable layer height.
notes.min_layer_height: The thinnest layer this nozzle can print, in mm. Limits variable layer height.
notes.nozzle_diameter: The size of the nozzle's opening, in mm. Line widths and layer heights are based on it, so it must match the nozzle fitted.
notes.nozzle_type: What the nozzle is made of, which decides which abrasive filaments it can print. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.print_core: The print core each extruder holds, such as AA 0.4 or BB 0.4. UltiMaker printers check it against the fitted core before they start.
notes.nozzle_volume: The volume inside the nozzle between the filament cutter and the tip, in mm3. Used to work out how much to purge on a filament change.
notes.parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas: Bed areas parallel printheads can't use. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.parallel_printheads_count: How many printheads print in parallel. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.pellet_modded_printer: Marks a printer converted to print from pellets. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.preferred_orientation: Turns imported models by this many degrees around Z. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printable_area: The shape and size of the bed the nozzle can reach, in mm.
notes.printable_height: The tallest part the printer can print, in mm.
notes.scan_first_layer: Has the printer's camera check the first layer. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.support_parallel_printheads: Marks a printer that can run several printheads at once. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.time_cost: What an hour of printer time costs. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.travel_slope: How steeply the nozzle climbs during slope and spiral z hop, in degrees. 90 lifts straight up like a normal z hop.
notes.use_relative_e_distances: Writes extruder moves as relative distances instead of a running total. Recommended for most printers and needed for the prime tower.
notes.wrapping_exclude_area: Areas skipped by the filament wrapping check. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.z_offset: Added to every Z height in the G-code, in mm. Use it to correct a nozzle that sits too high or low after homing; most printers set this in firmware instead.
notes.hotend_cooling_rate: How fast the hotend cools, in degrees per second. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.hotend_heating_rate: How fast the hotend heats, in degrees per second. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_damp_x: Input shaping damping for X. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_damp_y: Input shaping damping for Y. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_emit: Writes input shaping settings into the G-code. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_freq_x: Input shaping frequency for X, in Hz. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_freq_y: Input shaping frequency for Y, in Hz. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.input_shaping_type: The input shaping algorithm the firmware uses to cancel ringing. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_hotend_change_time: Time a hotend change takes, in seconds. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_max_acceleration_e: The highest extruder acceleration, in mm/s2. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted, and used for the time estimate.
notes.machine_max_acceleration_extruding: The highest acceleration while printing, in mm/s2 (M204 P). Faster settings are capped to it.
notes.machine_max_acceleration_retracting: The highest acceleration while retracting, in mm/s2 (M204 R).
notes.machine_max_acceleration_travel: The highest acceleration for travel moves, in mm/s2 (M204 T, Marlin 2 only).
notes.machine_max_acceleration_x: The highest X acceleration, in mm/s2. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted, and used for the time estimate.
notes.machine_max_acceleration_y: The highest Y acceleration, in mm/s2. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted, and used for the time estimate.
notes.machine_max_acceleration_z: The highest Z acceleration, in mm/s2. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted, and used for the time estimate.
notes.machine_max_jerk_e: The highest extruder jerk, in mm/s. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted.
notes.machine_max_jerk_x: The highest X jerk, in mm/s. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted.
notes.machine_max_jerk_y: The highest Y jerk, in mm/s. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted.
notes.machine_max_jerk_z: The highest Z jerk, in mm/s. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted.
notes.machine_max_junction_deviation: The firmware's junction deviation limit, in mm (M205 J), on Marlin with junction deviation. Set 0 if the printer uses classic jerk.
notes.machine_max_speed_e: The highest extruder speed, in mm/s. Written to the G-code when machine limits are emitted.
notes.machine_max_speed_x: The highest X speed the machine allows, in mm/s. Faster settings are capped to it, and the time estimate uses it.
notes.machine_max_speed_y: The highest Y speed the machine allows, in mm/s. Faster settings are capped to it, and the time estimate uses it.
notes.machine_max_speed_z: The highest Z speed the machine allows, in mm/s.
notes.max_resonance_avoidance_speed: Top of the speed band resonance avoidance steers clear of, in mm/s. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.min_resonance_avoidance_speed: Bottom of the speed band resonance avoidance steers clear of, in mm/s. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.resonance_avoidance: Avoids wall speeds where the printer frame resonates. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.cooling_tube_length: Length of the cooling tube on a single-nozzle multi-material printer, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.cooling_tube_retraction: Distance from the nozzle tip to the middle of the cooling tube, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.enable_filament_ramming: Rams the filament before unloading to shape a clean tip, on single-nozzle multi-material printers. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.extra_loading_move: Loads filament this much further (or less, if negative) than it was unloaded, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.high_current_on_filament_swap: Raises the extruder motor current during filament swaps. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_load_filament_time: Time a filament load takes, in seconds. Used only for the print time estimate.
notes.machine_tool_change_time: Time a tool change takes, in seconds. Used only for the print time estimate.
notes.machine_unload_filament_time: Time a filament unload takes, in seconds. Used only for the print time estimate.
notes.manual_filament_change: For swapping filament by hand: skips the tool change commands so the printer pauses for you. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.master_extruder_id: Which extruder is the main one on a two-nozzle printer, counted from 1.
notes.nozzle_flush_dataset: Which set of measured purge volumes the printer uses for color changes.
notes.purge_in_prime_tower: Purges the leftover old filament into the prime tower on a filament change.
notes.single_extruder_multi_material: The printer feeds several filaments through one nozzle, as with an AMS or MMU, so every color change needs a purge.
notes.support_object_skip_flush: Skips flushing between objects. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.tool_change_on_wipe_tower: Moves the head to the prime tower before each tool change. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.wait_for_temp_on_wipe_tower: Waits at the prime tower for the new tool to heat. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bbl_use_printhost: Sends prints to a Bambu Lab printer through a third-party print host. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.flashforge_serial_number: The printer's serial number, needed by Flashforge's local API. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.host_type: Which kind of print host the printer runs, such as OctoPrint, Moonraker or PrusaLink, so files are sent the right way.
notes.print_host: The address of the print host, such as its hostname, IP address or URL.
notes.print_host_webui: The address of the printer's web page, if it differs from the print host. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printer_agent: Which network agent talks to the printer. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printhost_apikey: The API key or password the print host needs.
notes.printhost_authorization_type: How the print host checks who you are. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printhost_cafile: A custom certificate file for HTTPS connections to the print host. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printhost_password: The password for the print host.
notes.printhost_port: The port or printer name on the print host. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke: Skips HTTPS certificate revocation checks. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.printhost_user: The user name for the print host.
notes.printer_notes: Your own notes about this printer.
notes.deretraction_speed: How fast the filament is pushed back after a retraction, in mm/s. 0 uses the retraction speed.
notes.parking_pos_retraction: Distance from the nozzle tip to where unloaded filament is parked, in mm. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.retract_after_wipe: How much of the retraction happens after the wipe, in percent. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.retract_before_wipe: How much of the retraction happens quickly before the wipe, in percent. The rest happens while the nozzle wipes.
notes.retract_length_toolchange: How far filament pulls back before a tool change, in mm, so the idle nozzle doesn't ooze.
notes.retract_speed_toolchange: How fast the filament pulls back by the tool change retraction length, in mm/s.
notes.toolchange_temperature_drop: How far under its print temperature a print core may start printing after a tool change, in degrees C. It heats the rest of the way while it prints.
notes.retract_lift_toolchange: How far the nozzle lifts before a tool change, in mm, staying up until the next print move.
notes.retract_lift_above: Z hop is used only above this height, in mm. 0 sets no limit.
notes.retract_lift_below: Z hop is used only below this height, in mm. 0 sets no limit.
notes.retract_lift_enforce: On which surfaces z hop is used: all, or only over top or bottom surfaces, where a scratch would show.
notes.retract_restart_extra: Extra filament pushed after a retraction, in mm, to make up for plastic that oozed during travel. Rarely needed.
notes.retract_restart_extra_toolchange: Extra filament pushed after a tool change, in mm. SlicerX does not add it yet.
notes.retract_when_changing_layer: Retracts on every layer change, which can reduce marks where layers start.
notes.retraction_length: How far filament pulls back before a travel move, so the nozzle doesn't ooze and string. Direct drive needs about 0.5 to 1 mm, Bowden 3 to 6 mm; 0 turns retraction off.
notes.retraction_minimum_travel: Travel moves shorter than this don't retract, in mm. Fewer retractions save time and wear on the filament.
notes.retraction_speed: How fast the filament pulls back, in mm/s. Faster stops oozing sooner; too fast can grind the filament.
notes.use_firmware_retraction: Lets the firmware do retraction with G10 and G11 instead of the slicer. You then tune retraction on the printer.
notes.wipe: Moves the nozzle back along the line it just printed while retracting, which wipes off ooze before travel.
notes.wipe_distance: How far the nozzle moves along the last line while wiping, in mm.
notes.wipe_tower_type: Which prime tower layout to build. Type 1 suits Bambu and Qidi printers with a filament cutter; type 2 suits tool changers and MMU printers.
notes.z_hop: How far the nozzle lifts before a travel move, in mm, so it doesn't drag across the print. Higher clears curled edges but can add stringing; 0.2 to 0.4 mm is typical.
notes.z_hop_types: How the nozzle lifts for travel. Normal lifts straight up; slope lifts while moving; spiral circles up, which can reduce stringing; auto picks per move.
notes.extruder_clearance_max_radius: The largest space the toolhead takes up, for printing by object. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.extruder_height_gap: The height gap between toolhead parts, for printing by object. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_switch_extruder_time: Time switching between the printer's extruders takes, in seconds. Used for the print time estimate.
notes.print_in_clockwise: Prints loops clockwise. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.detraction_speed: How fast filament is pushed back after a retraction, in mm/s. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.creality_flush_time: Time a flush takes on Creality multi-color printers, in seconds. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_LED_light_exist: Marks a printer with a chamber light. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_platform_motion_enable: Marks a printer whose bed moves. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.prime_tower_position_type: The maker's default spot for the prime tower. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and places the tower with atlas.
notes.color_bed_exclude_area: Bed areas excluded for multi-color prints. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.bed_texture_area: The textured area of the bed. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.machine_ptc_exist: Marks a printer with a PTC chamber heater. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.support_multi_filament: Marks a printer that can print several filaments. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.is_support_multi_box: Marks a printer that takes several filament boxes. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it yet.
notes.remaining_times: Writes M73 commands so the printer can show the time left.
notes.wave_overhangs: Prints overhangs as rings that grow outward from the supported edge, each resting on the last, so steep overhangs print without support. Slow, and best on flat overhangs.
notes.wave_overhang_line_spacing: How far each wave ring grows past the last, in mm.
notes.wave_overhang_perimeter_overlap: How far the first wave ring reaches back over the layer below to anchor itself, in mm.
notes.wave_overhang_print_speed: Speed of the wave rings, in mm/s. Very slow, around 2 mm/s, so each ring sets before the next.
notes.wave_overhang_flow_mm3_per_mm: Plastic per mm of wave ring, in mm3. More gives sturdier rings.
notes.wave_overhang_min_length: Wave rings shorter than this are skipped, in mm. 0 keeps them all.
notes.wave_overhang_min_new_area: Wave rings stop when a ring adds less area than this, in mm2.
notes.wave_overhang_max_iterations: The most wave rings an overhang may get. 0 sets no limit.
notes.printer_plugin_config_overrides: Plugin capability overrides as raw JSON. SlicerX keeps this for profile exchange and does not use it.
